_meta.scores_basis: 2026 intake (main round) weighted admission scores, Lingnan '2026 JUPAS Admission Scores (Main Round)' PDF
_meta.weights_basis: Lingnan 'JUPAS Admissions (2027 Entry)' PDF, section 5 Category A Subject Weighting for 2027 Entry

_meta.score_grades_note: score_grades_2026 holds the per-subject median/LQ weighted scores (chi/eng/math/e1/e2) exactly as printed; these are separate per-subject figures and must not be summed as one candidate
